title: mcp
description: let agents like claude search, save and edit your capystore library with the chat's tools.
unavailable: mcp settings are only available on the deployed site.
expired: your login expired. reload the page to sign in again.
mode.public.detail: /mcp plus a client key in the header. claude code, cursor.
mode.private.detail: the key lives in the link. claude.ai connectors. public url goes off.
confirm.private.title: turn on the private link?
confirm.private.body: you get a link with a key inside it, for claude.ai and apps that can't send a key. the public url stops answering, so anything set up with it (claude code with a key header) has to switch to the new link.
confirm.leave_private.title: go back to the public url?
confirm.leave_private.body: the private link stops working now and can't come back. agents connect at the public url with a client key again.
confirm.public.title: turn on the public url?
confirm.public.body: agents connect at the public url with a client key in the header.
confirm.off.title: turn mcp off?
confirm.off.body: no agent can connect through either url. upload links already handed out stop too.
confirm.rotate.title: rotate the private link?
confirm.rotate.body: the old link stops working right away. paste the new one into claude.ai (settings › connectors) to keep it connected.
off.title: no agent can connect
off.body: both urls answer "not found". pick public url or private link to turn mcp on.
public.title: public url
public.header: needs a client key in the header:
public.claude_ai: claude.ai can't send a header. for claude.ai connectors, switch to a private link.
private.title: private link
private.rotate_hint: the link is shown once, when it's made. lost it? rotate to get a new one; the old one stops at once.
private.public_off: the public url is off while the private link is on.
reveal.title: your private link
reveal.warning: copy it now. it won't be shown again, and anyone with it can use your library.
reveal.copy_failed: couldn't copy automatically. select the link and copy it by hand.
steps.title: add it to claude.ai
steps.1: turn on the private link and copy it
steps.2: claude.ai › settings › connectors › add custom connector
steps.3: name it capystore, paste the link, leave oauth empty, add
error.not_private: the private link is off. turn it on first.
